notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAinteractionsReceived attribute. The test uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application interaction and parameter names. It checks the initial zero, a direct count of three after three application Receive Interaction callbacks, a periodic count of five after two more callbacks, and the unchanged direct count after periodic reporting is disabled. No provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics are used.
